args.title: Document limits on report fields in the API reference
args.body:
File: docs/API.md

Add the limits for report fields (report name length up to 120 characters, categories list up to 50 items with 60 characters per category, and scheduled export recipients up to 20 emails) to the Reports section of the API reference so client forms can validate them.
